---
name: Font Patch Request
about: Get missing glyphs patched into your fonts. Upload ONE zip containing up to 10 .ttf files.
title: "[Font Patch] "
labels: ["font-patch"]
---

**GitHub does not allow raw fonts, so you must zip them first.**

1. Put up to **10** `.ttf` files into a single `.zip` file. **Only `.ttf` is accepted.** `.otf`, renamed OTFs, and emoji fonts will be rejected.
2. Drag and drop that single `.zip` file anywhere in the text box and wait for the upload to finish before submitting.
3. Do not attach more than one zip. You can leave these instructions here; the workflow will find your zip automatically.
4. **Warning:** Missing glyphs are filled with Roboto shapes. Flashing a bad font can bootloop your phone. **Keep a backup.**
5. **Ownership:** The font belongs to its original creator. This workflow does not remove author/license data. Contact the maintainer for takedowns.

**Something wrong?** Open a **Problem Report** instead of commenting here.
